defs.def: to say hello to sb in a friendly way when they arrive somewhere （打招呼）欢迎（某人的到来）

ex.s: We welcome volunteers to help transform reclaimed materials into objects with new and creative purposes.
ex.t: 我们欢迎志愿者帮忙将回收材料改造成具有崭新而富有创意用途的物品。

ex.s: We look forward to welcoming you as we showcase the creativity of the Harvard arts community through performances, art exhibitions and art-making activities.
ex.t: 我们期待欢迎你，通过表演、艺术展览和创作活动展示哈佛艺术社区的创造力。

ex.s: •One welcoming session on the second Friday of the term
ex.t: • 在第二个星期五举行一次欢迎会议

ex.s: Welcome to Amsterdam, welcome to MacBike.
ex.t: 欢迎来到阿姆斯特丹，欢迎来到MacBike。

ex.s: Welcome to the club；we’ve all been there.
ex.t: 欢迎加入这个行列；我们都经历过。

ex.s: Welcome to UCLA Exchange Program!
ex.t: 欢迎来到UCLA交换项目！

ex.s: These gentle, lovely gatekeepers welcomed her and kick-started what was to be a trip Ginni would never forget.
ex.t: 这些温柔可爱的守门人欢迎了她，开启了Ginni永远不会忘记的一段旅程。

ex.s: Paul Beer, head of rhino section at Port Lympne, said: “Obviously we're all absolutely delighted to welcome another calf to our black rhino family.
ex.t: 波特·林普恩犀牛部门主管保罗·比尔说："显然我们都非常高兴欢迎另一头小犀牛加入我们的黑犀牛家族。

ex.s: Most museums also welcome school groups and arrange special activities for children.
ex.t: 大多数博物馆也欢迎学生团体，并为孩子们安排特别活动。

ex.s: Welcome to Holker Hall & Gardens
ex.t: 欢迎来到霍尔克庄园和花园

ex.s: There, they were welcomed to the Chinese-style compound where they were to live.
ex.t: 在那里，他们受到欢迎来到他们住的地方的中国式大院。

ex.s: He also saw hundreds of delighted students who had turned out to welcome him.
ex.t: 他还看到数百名高兴的学生前来欢迎他。

ex.s: Volunteers aged 10 and over are welcome.
ex.t: 欢迎10岁及以上的志愿者参加。

defs.def: to be pleased that sb has come or has joined an organization, activity, etc. 欢迎（新来的人）；迎新

ex.s: Artist Michael Craig-Martin said: “Andria's brilliant project to bring artists from all fields into direct contact with children is particularly welcome at a time when the arts are being downgraded in schools." It was a mistake to see the arts as unnecessary, he added.
ex.t: 艺术家Michael Craig-Martin说：“Andria这个将各领域艺术家与儿童直接联系起来的出色项目，在学校艺术教育被贬低之际尤其值得欢迎。”他补充说，把艺术视为可有可无是一种错误。

ex.s: welcome new studentsD. work on weekly videos
ex.t: 欢迎新学生D. 制作每周视频

ex.s: Wendy Wilson, extra care manager at 60 Penfold Street, one of the first to embark on the project, said: “Residents really welcome the idea of the project and the creative sessions.
ex.t: Penfold街60号的额外护理经理Wendy Wilson是最早参与该项目的人之一，她说："居民们非常欢迎这个项目和创意活动。

ex.s: Your student ID card will be provided to you by your department during Welcome Week.
ex.t: 你的学生证卡将在迎新周期间由你的部门提供给你。

ex.s: Please be aware that you will not receive this smart card during Welcome Week if you do not upload your image online by 4 September 2020.
ex.t: 请注意如果你不在2020年9月4日之前在线上传你的照片你在迎新周期间将不会收到这张智能卡。

ex.s: Wang Lei Walking group welcomes new members!
ex.t: 王磊 徒步小组欢迎新成员加入！

ex.s: Orientation Day is a way to welcome new students and help them know the school, including its history, campus, facilities and other relevant information.
ex.t: 迎新日是欢迎新生的一种方式，帮助他们了解学校，包括学校的历史、校园、设施和其他相关信息。

defs.def: to be pleased to receive or accept sth 乐意接纳；欣然接受

ex.s: In Bellevue, the switch to adaptive signals has been a lesson in the value of welcoming new approaches.
ex.t: “它不能解决所有问题，但对较小的城市来说，自适应信号灯有一些好处，”他说。

defs.def: that you are pleased to have, receive, etc. 令人愉快的；受欢迎的

ex.s: On the other side of my bed curtain, I heard a patient cheerfully  18  every nurse as they entered the room, as if welcoming each into his home.
ex.t: 在我的床帘另一边，我听到一位病人愉快地18 每一位进来的护士，仿佛欢迎她们来到他的家中。

ex.s: Breathtaking views of the lowlands of Carlow can be enjoyed in the presence of welcoming guides from local walking clubs.
ex.t: 在当地徒步俱乐部热情向导的陪伴下，你可以欣赏卡洛低地令人惊叹的景色。

ex.s: There’s a welcome familiarity — but also sometimes a slight suspicion that time has changed you both, and thus the relationship.
ex.t: 有一种令人欣慰的熟悉感——但有时也会有一丝怀疑：时间改变了你们双方，也因此改变了这段关系。

ex.s: I tried skateboarding there, but the locals were far less welcoming.
ex.t: 我在那里尝试滑板运动，但当地人远没有那么热情。

defs.def: （表示乐于让某人做某事）可随意

ex.s: Banned from the hotel since 2001.Burchill is now welcome to come back, the Fairmont said.
ex.t: 自2001年起被禁止入住该酒店。费尔蒙酒店表示，伯奇尔现在可以回来了。

defs.def: （表示十分乐于让他人取去自己不想要的事物）尽管 … 好了
something that you do or say to sb when they arrive, especially sth that makes them feel you are happy to see them 迎接；接待；欢迎

ex.s: I am one of the faces of Toronto that welcome millions of air travellers from all over the world.
ex.t: 我是那张迎接来自世界各地数百万旅客的多伦多的面孔之一。

ex.s: Poppy welcomed them home as usual but when she saw the box, she stopped.
ex.t: Poppy像往常一样欢迎他们回家，但当她看到盒子时，她停下来了。

defs.def: the way that people react to sth, which shows their opinion of it （表明看法的）反应方式，对待，接受
